== Summary ==
[[2009 World Championship]], Clarion Hotel, Princeton, New Jersey, 11 October 2009 (date from the camera's date stamp): "this got a lot worse" (cards spread across a table).

== Source ==
Photo by Flickr user punkybear (forum user Nibcrom), album "philly and jersey worlds": [https://www.flickr.com/photos/punkybear/4096154799/ this got a lot worse] (original image https://live.staticflickr.com/2612/4096154799_69f03b1866_b.jpg). Several were posted to the forum thread [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=31192 2009 Worlds pictures] (topic 31192), e.g. [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=482550#p482550 post by Nibcrom], 12 November 2009. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261105005202/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t31192.html Internet Archive]
